description: This file defines API route handlers for registration-related operations in a web server, including search, retrieval, registration, and renewal of tourist data, using Express.js routing.

methods.name: router.use
methods.description: Applies authentication middleware to all registration routes.

methods.name: router.get('/search')
methods.description: Handles GET requests for searching tourists.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific tourist by ID.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to register a new tourist.

methods.name: router.post('/:id/renew')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to renew a tourist's registration.
